name: Gregory T. Papanikos
detail: 2015 paper advocates a broad tax on assets, but defines wealth as assets without establishing a net-of-debt basis. Removed pending evidence of a qualifying net or otherwise included design.

name: Spyros Papaspyros
detail: 2011 signatory and former ADEDY president; died in January 2019.

name: Antonis Schwarz
detail: Germany-based campaigner; his international statement belongs in the German register, where he is already recorded.

name: Dimitris Konstadellis
detail: ELIAMEP policy paper (Sept 2025) calls an annual progressive global wealth tax the ideal but utopian, and proposes a different instrument (auctioned privileges) instead; not support for a wealth tax.
